title: Grade 10 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #7

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Types of Divorce? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Types of Divorce has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Types of Divorce to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of Divorce.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Funeral Rites? (1 mark)
   A. Say Funeral Rites has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Funeral Rites.
   C. Use Funeral Rites to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an? (1 mark)
   A. Use Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an.
   C. Say Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected verses Surah al- Furqan to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected verses Surah al- Furqan has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected verses Surah al- Furqan.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Hadith? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Hadith has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Selected Hadith to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Hadith.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Prayers on special occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Prayers on special occasions has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Prayers on special occasions.
   C. Use Prayers on special occasions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Administration of Zakat? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Administration of Zakat.
   B. Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Administration of Zakat to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Administration of Zakat has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Types of verses? (1 mark)
   A. Use Types of verses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Types of verses.
   C. Say Types of verses has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. Which response best shows understanding of Care for widows? (1 mark)
   A. Use Care for widows to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Care for widows.
   C. Say Care for widows has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Asbabu al- nuzuul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Asbabu al- nuzuul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Asbabu al- nuzuul has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Asbabu al- nuzuul.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Types of verses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Asbabu al- nuzuul and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Selected verses Surah al- Furqan and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. A — Apply the teaching of Types of Divorce with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. D — Apply the teaching of Funeral Rites with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. D — Apply the teaching of Diacriticalisation of the Qur’an with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Apply the teaching of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Selected Hadith with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Prayers on special occasions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. B — Apply the teaching of Administration of Zakat with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Types of verses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. D — Apply the teaching of Care for widows with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Asbabu al- nuzuul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Types of verses; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Asbabu al- nuzuul; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Selected verses Surah al- Furqan; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Ulum al- Hadith Isnad Matn; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
